title: M6: Web IDE — editor, multi-file projects, terminal
description: Intent: As the student, I want a browser IDE with a file tree, tabs, syntax highlighting, a Run button and a terminal pane, so that I can write and run small multi-file projects from anywhere. Includes: Vite/React/Monaco, create/rename/delete files, language selection (Python/C/C++), project persistence, session start on open to hide cold start, terminal pane wired to M3. Excludes: collaborative editing, debugger. DoD: browser-driven Gherkin specs create a two-file C++ project, run it, interact with it, and reload to find it saved.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Dependency: the IDE needs a sign-in screen and token handling from M5 (Google sign-in via Cognito) before it can start cloud sessions. Local development can use a bypass.

comments.author: home
comments.text: M6 merged to develop (PR #3): Vite/React/Monaco/xterm IDE with Google sign-in client, 21 browser specs against a mock backend. Review fixes applied (warm-up deadline, stale-run recovery, storage hardening, path validation, SSE cleanup, terminal EOF/Ctrl-C, auth error screens). Not yet verified against real Cognito or runner.

comments.text: Web IDE deployed at the CloudFront site; waiting on real sign-in and run.
